evidence: Extensively updates wallet transaction creation (spend.cpp), coin selection, fee bumping (feebumper.cpp), and wallet persistence (walletdb.cpp).
rationale: Adds BIP 352 Silent Payment sending support to Bitcoin Core, solving an address-reuse and privacy gap for users paying silent payment recipients. As part of tracking issue #28536, it provides major user-facing value and unblocks downstream silent payment functionality (#32966).
